cases.name: Kellie Jean Poppleton
cases.about: She was a student at Conrad Noll School in Fremont, CA.
cases.narrative: On 12/2/1983, her body was found dead on the side of Kilkare Road in Sunol, CA. She was covered in bruises and her head was wrapped in two plastic shopping bags, and a crudely designed noose, made from a tie, was wound tightly around her neck. She had been strangled with a television coaxial cable, battered almost beyond identification with brass knuckles and a club, and sexually assaulted with a blunt instrument.
